name: io.github.cedricweb3coding/omnikalc
title: Omnikalc calculators
description: About 4,800 calculators and unit converters (en, fr, es): search, read formulas, compute.

tools.name: search_calculators
tools.description: Find Omnikalc calculators (and unit-converter hubs) by keywords, e.g. "mortgage payment", "body fat", "concrete slab". Returns ids to use with get_calculator and calculate, plus the page URL of each. For plain unit conversions (kg to lb, °C to °F) use convert_units directly.

category.description: Optional category slug from list_categories to narrow the search.

language.description: Language of the calculators and of the returned links (en, fr, es). Defaults to en.

query.description: What you want to calculate, in the chosen language.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: List the Omnikalc categories (finance, health, construction…) with the number of calculators in each. Use a slug as the category filter of search_calculators.

language.description: Language of the calculators and of the returned links (en, fr, es). Defaults to en.

tools.name: get_calculator
tools.description: Describe one calculator: what it computes, every input (id, label, unit options, min/max, default), every output with its formula, FAQ highlights, related calculators and its page URL. Call it before calculate to learn the input ids.

calculator_id.description: Calculator id as returned by search_calculators ("en/real-estate/mortgage-payment-borrowing-capacity"), or an omnikalc.com page URL, or just the slug together with `language`.

language.description: Language of the calculators and of the returned links (en, fr, es). Defaults to en.

tools.name: calculate
tools.description: Run a calculator with the given inputs and return every result, formatted for the language, with interpretation labels when the calculator has them. Inputs you leave out use the calculator's defaults (the answer lists which). The answer includes the Omnikalc page URL with your inputs prefilled: show it to the user.

calculator_id.description: Calculator id as returned by search_calculators ("en/real-estate/mortgage-payment-borrowing-capacity"), or an omnikalc.com page URL, or just the slug together with `language`.

inputs.description: Input values keyed by input id (see get_calculator). Numbers for number inputs; for a select/radio the option value or its label; true/false for a toggle; "YYYY-MM-DD" for a date; "HH:MM" for a time.

language.description: Language of the calculators and of the returned links (en, fr, es). Defaults to en.

units.description: Unit symbols keyed by input id or output id, for inputs/outputs that offer units (e.g. {"weight": "kg"}). Omitted ones use the default unit. The value given in `inputs` is expressed in the chosen unit.

tools.name: convert_units
tools.description: Convert a value between two units (length, mass, volume, temperature, speed, area, energy, cooking measures, fuel economy…). Units can be given as a symbol, name or plural in the chosen language ("kg", "pounds", "°C", "cups").

language.description: Language of the calculators and of the returned links (en, fr, es). Defaults to en.

quantity.description: Only to disambiguate a unit that exists in several quantities (e.g. "oz" for weight or volume).
